'''''Orthotrichum''''' is a genus of [[moss]] in the family [[Orthotrichaceae]]. It is distributed throughout the world.<ref>Lewinsky-Haapasaari, J. and L. Hedenäs. (1998). [https://www.jstor.org/stable/3244527?seq=1#page_scan_tab_contents A cladistic analysis of the moss genus ''Orthotrichum''.] ''The Bryologist''. 101(4) 519-55.</ref>

There are about 125 species in the genus.<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=123298 ''Orthotrichum''.] Flora of North America.</ref>

Species include:<ref>[http://plants.usda.gov/plant-profile?symbol=ORTHO4 ''Orthotrichum''.] USDA PLANTS.</ref>
